Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The InformationExtraction_Expert failed to utilize its core capability of browsing the web or accessing local files to find the specific papers. Instead of immediately searching for the known, highly cited Fast Radio Burst (FRB) papers from 2020 and 2021 (likely by authors like CHIME/FRB collaborations or specific researchers like Spitler, Kaplan, etc.), the agent blindly ran code (`arxiv_search`) that returned no results. This indicates a failure to execute the search correctly or to recognize that the papers might be under different titles or authors, leading to an immediate dead end. The agent repeatedly repeated the same failed search strategy without adapting to the reality that the search function was not working as expected for known data, ultimately concluding the task was impossible when it was solvable with the right search terms or data access.
